create_patch_camelyon_data_files: create Patch Camelyon dataset files from h5 inputs to a disk_folder output with train and val splits
run_patch_camelyon_download: run the script to download and decompress Patch Camelyon h5.gz files into the input folder
build_patch_camelyon_split: build a PatchCamelyon dataset instance for a given split with input and output paths
create_disk_folder_split: create a disk_folder split by converting h5 image arrays to jpg files in tumor and no_tumor directories
get_argument_parser: get an argument parser with input, output, and download flags for the Patch Camelyon data creation script
